items.source: The default implementation builds a ConcurrentWebSocketSessionDecorator with the configured send-time limit and buffer-size limit.
items.translation: 默认实现会构建一个 `ConcurrentWebSocketSessionDecorator`，并配置其 `send-time limit` 和 `buffer-size limit`。

items.source: Also an implementation of MessageHandler that finds the WebSocket session associated with the Message and passes it, along with the message, to the sub-protocol handler to send messages from the application back to the client.
items.translation: 同样，这是一个 `MessageHandler` 的实现，它会查找与 `Message` 关联的 WebSocket 会话，并将该会话连同消息一起传递给子协议处理器，以便将应用程序的消息发送回客户端。

items.source: The LifecycleProcessor will call only this variant of the stop method; i.e. Lifecycle.stop() will not be called for SmartLifecycle implementations unless explicitly delegated to within the implementation of this method.
items.translation: `LifecycleProcessor` 将仅调用此版本的 `stop` 方法；即，除非在该方法的实现中显式委托，否则不会为 `SmartLifecycle` 实现调用 `Lifecycle.stop()`。

items.source: The default implementation returns SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE in order to let stop() callbacks execute before regular Lifecycle implementations.
items.translation: 默认实现返回SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE，以便在常规的Lifecycle实现之前执行stop()回调。

items.source: The provided callback is used by the LifecycleProcessor to support an ordered, and potentially concurrent, shutdown of all components having a common shutdown order value. The callback must be executed after the SmartLifecycle component does indeed stop.
items.translation: 提供的回调由LifecycleProcessor使用，以支持具有公共关闭顺序值的所有组件的有序且可能并发的关闭。该回调必须在SmartLifecycle 组件确实停止后执行。

items.source: By default, this is SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE, but with @EnableWebSocketMessageBroker configuration it is set to 0.
items.translation: 默认情况下，这是SmartLifecycle.DEFAULT_PHASE，但在使用@EnableWebSocketMessageBroker配置时，它被设置为 0。

items.source: The default implementation delegates to Lifecycle.stop() and immediately triggers the given callback in the calling thread. Note that there is no synchronization between the two, so custom implementations may at least want to put the same steps within their common lifecycle monitor (if any).
items.translation: 默认实现会委托给 Lifecycle.stop()，并立即在调用线程中触发给定的回调。请注意，这两者之间没有同步机制，因此自定义实现至少应该将其中的相同步骤放在其公共生命周期监视器（如果有）内。

items.source: In the case of a container, this will return true only if all components that apply are currently running.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，仅当所有适用的组件当前都在运行时，此方法才返回 `true`。

items.source: By default this is set to 60,000 (1 minute).
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为60,000（1 分钟）。

items.source: Note that this stop notification is not guaranteed to come before destruction: On regular shutdown, Lifecycle beans will first receive a stop notification before the general destruction callbacks are being propagated; however, on hot refresh during a context's lifetime or on aborted refresh attempts, a given bean's destroy method will be called without any consideration of stop signals upfront.
items.translation: 请注意，此停止通知并不保证在销毁之前发出： 在常规关闭过程中，Lifecycle 圈会先接收停止通知，然后再传播通用的销毁回调；然而，在上下文生命周期期间的热刷新或中止的刷新尝试中，给定 bean 的销毁方法将在不考虑任何预先停止信号的情况下被调用。

items.source:
This handler is for WebSocket connections that use a sub-protocol.
Therefore, we expect the client to send at least one sub-protocol message
in the beginning, or else we assume the connection isn't doing well, for example,
proxy issue, slow network, and can be closed.
items.translation: 此处理器用于使用子协议的 WebSocket 连接。因此，我们期望客户端在开始时至少发送一条子协议消息；否则，我们将假设连接状态不佳（例如代理问题或网络缓慢），并可以将其关闭。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is already running.
items.translation: 如果组件已经在运行，则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate a hard start signal to all
components that apply, even to non-auto-startup components.
items.translation: 对于容器而言，这将向所有适用的组件传播硬启动信号，即使包括非自动启动的组件。

items.source: Should not throw an exception if the component is not running (not started yet).
items.translation: 如果组件尚未运行（尚未启动），则不应抛出异常。

items.source:
In the case of a container, this will propagate the stop signal to all components
that apply.
items.translation: 对于容器，这将向所有适用的组件传播停止信号。

items.source: Whether the WebSocketHandler handles partial messages. If this flag is set to true and the underlying WebSocket server supports partial messages, then a large WebSocket message, or one of an unknown size may be split and maybe received over multiple calls to WebSocketHandler.handleMessage(WebSocketSession, WebSocketMessage). The flag WebSocketMessage.isLast() indicates if the message is partial and whether it is the last part.
items.translation: WebSocketHandler 是否处理部分消息。如果此标志设置为true，且底层 WebSocket 服务器支持部分消息，则大型 WebSocket 消息或大小未知的消息可能会被拆分，并通过多次调用WebSocketHandler.handleMessage(WebSocketSession, WebSocketMessage)接收。标志WebSocketMessage.isLast()指示消息是否为部分消息以及是否为最后一部分。

Invoked after the WebSocket connection has been closed by either side, or after a
transport error has occurred. Although the session may technically still be open,
depending on the underlying implementation, sending messages at this point is
discouraged and most likely will not succeed.
items.translation: 在 WebSocket 连接被任一方关闭或发生传输错误后调用。尽管会话在技术上可能仍然处于打开状态，但具体取决于底层实现，此时发送消息是不建议的，并且很可能无法成功。
